name: Pale Hand
description: Strike with the school's founding touch that drains the colour from the struck skin.

name: Pale Screen
description: Hold a pale screen of qi before the chest that takes the warmth out of an incoming blow.

name: Paling Step
description: Step with the body gone pale and quiet so the foe loses the thread of its movement.

name: Sallow Grip
description: Hold the foe's wrist until a sallow weakness crawls up the arm and locks it.

name: Gaunting Palm
description: Strike the belly with a palm that leaves the whole frame gaunt and trembling.

name: Pale Remission
description: Lay a pale palm on an ally's chest and let a wasting fever pass out through the skin.

name: Whitening Touch
description: Touch the breastbone and bleach the strength from the whole torso in one pulse.

name: Pallor Respite
description: Draw a deep poison to the surface of an ally's skin and let it blanch away.

name: Pale Edict
description: Pronounce a pale edict over a foe and hold every limb of his body weak for as long as the edict is kept.

name: Whitening Hand
description: The school's finishing touch that bleaches the foe's strength in proportion to the qi the master pours into the palm.

name: Quietus Palm
description: Strike with a palm of cool sky-pale qi that stills the muscle it touches.

name: Quietus Cover
description: Sweep a quieting cover across the front and turn a thrust off into the air.

name: Skyfall Glide
description: Glide down and aside like a feather settling and leave the foe's blow behind.

name: Drowsing Touch
description: Rest a hand on the neck and let a drowsy weight sink into the foe's limbs.

name: Cool Thrust
description: Thrust a cool lance of qi through the guard that numbs everything it passes.

name: Meridian Calm
description: Soothe an ally's troubled meridians until a small backlash dies down and fades.

name: Lull Surge
description: Send a surge of lulling qi into the foe's head so the mind slackens and wanders.

name: Torpor Strike
description: Strike the base of the spine and send a deep torpor through all four limbs.

name: Quietus Balm
description: Spread a quieting balm of cool qi through an ally that drains a binding curse out of the veins.

name: Azure Torpor
description: Spread the sky-pale quiet over a group of foes and let it sink into every limb at once.

name: Final Quietus
description: The school's great quiet that settles on a foe until the strength of every limb ends together.

name: Ebbing Palm
description: Strike with a palm that pulls the strength out as the blow lands and leaves it hanging.

name: Wane Ward
description: Raise a grey ward from the qi field that thins any blow that passes through.

name: Waning Stride
description: Stride on the edge of the field where the qi falls away and the body is hard to track.

name: Dim Mote
description: Loose a dim mote of ending qi that drains a spot of strength where it hits.

name: Grey Tide
description: Tip a measure of the stored qi outward in a grey tide that wearies nearby foes.

name: Brimming Hold
description: Keep a brimming hold on a foe's limbs with the stored qi pressing gently down.

name: Ebb Draught
description: Give an ally a draught of stilled qi that ebbs a poison out of the blood.

name: Overflowing Pall
description: Let the pall brim over the edge of the field and numb those who stand just outside it.

name: Slow Deluge
description: Let grey waves of ending qi wash outward and wither all living things in reach.

name: Stilled Cup
description: Make the field a still basin in which a deep curse and its cause settle and clear.

name: Lethal Brim
description: Fill the field to the brim and let it break over every foe in a single grey surge.

name: Store Unfilled
description: The school's emptying of the full basin in one breath whose reach and weight follow the qi stored.

name: Convergent Palm
description: Strike with the left and right palm along two tracks of ending qi that meet in the target.

name: Dual Pall
description: Spread two overlapping palls from the core to dull blows from both sides.

name: Core Fade
description: Fade along a core-drawn line so the body slips off the foe's reach.

name: Convergent Rot
description: Drive two lines of rot into a foe's body so that they meet at the heart.

name: Parallel Drain
description: Pull vitality off a foe on two tracks at once so the draining doubles.

name: Track Release
description: Run one track of release down each of an ally's arms and clear a binding curse.

name: Terminal Cleft
description: Cleave the foe's guard between the two tracks and drive both ends into one wound.

name: Core Remission
description: Wash the damage of a harsh breakthrough or deviation out of an ally's core and meridians.

name: Terminal Tide
description: Send both tracks out in a vast tide of ending that wastes the life of everything it crosses.

name: Terminal Crown
description: The school's high crown where both tracks meet and a single ending falls whose weight follows the core.

name: Ebbing Fist
description: Strike with a fist sworn to take strength from the foe as a wind falls.

name: Windfall Guard
description: Turn a blow aside with the forearm as a falling wind turns a leaf.

name: Lull Pace
description: Move in the lull between two gusts and let the foe's strike land late.

name: Sworn Sap
description: Swear a sapping on the foe and let his strength drain a little with each breath.

name: Gale Ebb
description: Send a gale into its ebb across a foe so his legs lose their drive.

name: Oathed Wither
description: Wither one arm with a sworn touch that cannot be shaken off by effort alone.

name: Strain Ebb
description: Ebb the strain of a hard exertion or a minor poison out of an ally's limbs.

name: Sapping Gust
description: Loose a hollow gust across a group of foes and sap the strength of their legs.

name: Ebbing Sovereignty
description: Claim the strength of every foe in reach as the wind's to take and let it ebb.

name: Windborne Solace
description: Bear an ally's deep illness off on a sworn wind and let it fall far away.

name: Ending Gale
description: Raise a gale that carries ending across a wide front and drops the strength of all it crosses.

name: Falling Oath
description: The school's great oath of ebbing that drops every limb of a sworn foe as a wind drops.

name: Fallow Palm
description: Strike with a palm that leaves the struck place barren for a time and slow to answer.

name: Barren Guard
description: Plant a barren guard of withered qi that gives a blow nothing to grip.

name: Resting Step
description: Step as if to rest and be elsewhere before the foe's blow arrives.

name: Parched Hold
description: Dry the strength from a foe's grip until the weapon slips from his hand.

name: Stunting Palm
description: Strike the foe's centre so nothing in his frame can gather strength for a while.

name: Fallow Remedy
description: Rest a hand on an ally and let a clinging taint lie fallow and die out.

name: Withering Spread
description: Spread a broad slow withering across a patch of ground and all who stand in it.

name: Fallow Season
description: Give allies a long fallow rest in which curses and sickness fade without trace.

name: Great Blight
description: Blight a great stretch of open ground until nothing living on it keeps its strength.

name: Great Fallow
description: The school's great fallowing that lays a stretch of ground and its living things barren by the qi given.

name: Ageing Palm
description: Strike with a palm that ages the cloth and leather it touches by years in a heartbeat.

name: Ageing Ward
description: Hold a ward that ages anything of the foe's that crosses it and spares allies.

name: Gust Fade
description: Fade on a passing gust and settle a few paces from the foe's swing.

name: Windworn Rot
description: Throw rot on a gust at a distant foe so it takes hold on arrival.

name: Gale Fatigue
description: Let the gale carry a heavy fatigue to the foes it crosses.

name: Gust Remission
description: Let the wind lift a poison out of an ally and scatter it harmlessly.

name: Entropy Mantle
description: Wear a mantle of ageing wind that wearies any foe who strikes it.

name: Gale Corrosion
description: Drive a corroding gale over the field that ages gear and flesh alike.

name: Sworn Remission
description: Swear an ally free of a long curse and let the wind carry the debt away.

name: Ageing Tempest
description: Raise a tempest that ages everything it touches while allies stand untouched in its eye.

name: Entropy Oath
description: The school's oath of entropy that ages the foe's side and spares the sworn by the qi given.

name: Last Fist
description: Strike with a fist that leaves a dying stillness in the struck muscle.

name: Lasting Guard
description: Take a blow on a guard sworn to hold until the user's last breath.

name: Undersweep
description: Slip under a swing on a low sweeping step that follows the last of the wind.

name: Slackening Calm
description: Bring a calm over the foe's breath that slows his reactions without a blow.

name: Last Draft
description: Drive a thin last draft of ending through the guard and into the vital centre.

name: Dying Lull
description: Let a dying lull pass through the foe so every motion comes slower than intended.

name: Hushed Release
description: Release an ally from a poison on a hushed breath and let the cause fade.

name: Core Wither
description: Wither the qi at the foe's core so his reserves drop away.

name: Terminal Draft
description: Send the last wind over a wide front so all within lose strength and heat.

name: Mercy Wind
description: Let the last wind pass kindly over allies and strip a curse from each.

name: Last Falling
description: Let the last wind fall over the field and still the strength of all that breathe within it.

name: Final Oath
description: The school's deepest oath whose ending cannot be outrun and whose weight follows the core given.
